summary.text: Amy Barry-Macaulay is Labor's candidate for Gippsland South at the 2026 Victorian election, against Nationals leader Danny O'Brien. A lawyer, she has worked across health, education and the environment, and according to the ABC she has served as chief of staff to a federal MP. Her Labor page gives a campaign email and social accounts but no biography.

prior_roles.role: Chief of staff to a federal MP
prior_roles.note: The ABC does not name the MP or say when she held the role, or whether it has ended.

sources.title: Gippsland South: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Amy Barry-Macaulay, Labor candidate for Gippsland South, Victorian Labor

summary.text: Bianca Wilkie is One Nation's candidate for Gippsland South at the 2026 Victorian election; her party's page and local news coverage spell her surname Wilkie, while the ABC guide, which this tracker follows for lower-house names, spells it Wilke. She has worked for about 11 years in ambulance and emergency health care in Gippsland, much of that time around Yarram, and the Council of Ambulance Authorities included her in its 2026 Women in Ambulance honours. She has degrees in paramedicine, nursing and specialist community care and is studying for a Juris Doctor.

occupation.text: Paramedic and emergency health care worker

priorities.text: Return more state money to rural and regional communities through services, infrastructure and economic growth
Accountable, transparent government whose spending delivers results for local communities
Bring a regional voice to State Parliament, visiting every community in the electorate during the campaign

sources.title: Gippsland South: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
One Nation unveils Gippsland South candidate, South Gippsland Sentinel-Times, 1 Sep 2026

summary.text: Danny O'Brien has been the Nationals member for Gippsland South since winning a 2015 by-election, and has led the Victorian Nationals since November 2024. He first entered Parliament in 2014, appointed to fill a Legislative Council vacancy in Eastern Victoria Region. He is recontesting Gippsland South in 2026.

prior_roles.role: Shadow Minister for Regional Development and Liveability, Emergency Services, and Roads and Road Safety
prior_roles.note: Current portfolios on his Parliament page; no start year given.

prior_roles.role: Chief of staff to Barnaby Joyce as federal agriculture minister
Senior adviser to Deputy Prime Minister Mark Vaile
Chief of staff and media adviser to Nationals leader Peter Ryan
Agriculture and trade policy adviser, Australian Embassy in Jakarta
Television journalist, including Deputy State News Director at WIN TV in Ballarat

priorities.text: A fairer deal for people in country Victoria
Backing farmers and other primary producers

summary.text: Jessica McAuliffe is the Animal Justice Party's candidate for Gippsland South at the 2026 Victorian election, according to the VEC's list of nominations; before nominations closed she was listed second on the party's Eastern Victoria Region ticket. Her party page says she grew up in Korumburra and has worked in law since starting as a legal secretary in 2008. She holds a Juris Doctor and manages the practice at Oldham Family Law in Drouin.

occupation.text: Practice manager, Oldham Family Law, Drouin

previous_candidacies.note: Same name and party; no source we found says this is the same person.

priorities.text: More help for wildlife carers and rescue groups, and protection of native habitat
Affordable housing, health and mental health care and public transport in regional areas

summary.text: Lachie McGennisken is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Gippsland South at the 2026 Victorian election. He works as a support worker while studying at university, and he was raised in the Latrobe Valley and on the Bass Coast. His campaign argues for more public investment in services and against coal and the far right.

priorities.text: More investment in schools, and more hospital beds and health workers
Publicly run childcare and aged care
Moving away from coal towards a sustainable future in the face of climate change
Opposing One Nation and far-right politics, and standing up for workers and migrants

sources.title: Gippsland South: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Phillip Schuhmann is an independent candidate for Gippsland South at the 2026 Victorian election. According to the ABC's candidate notes, he farms, teaches music and runs his own arborist business, and has spent his whole life in the Strzelecki Ranges. His campaign is on Facebook, which was not used as a source, and no other biography was found.

occupation.text: Farmer, music teacher and arborist business owner

sources.title: Gippsland South: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Zave Evans is the Greens candidate for Gippsland South at the 2026 Victorian election. An environmentalist, he has done conservation and seasonal land management work and community projects, and has fought bushfires on the front line. He has travelled and worked widely in regional Australia.

occupation.text: Environmentalist; conservation and land management work

priorities.text: Practical discussion of bushfire risk and land use
The influence of multinational corporations in regional Australia
Bridging divides between the electorate's different communities
I want politics to focus on solutions that actually benefit people and place

sources.title: Gippsland South: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Zave Evans, Candidate for Gippsland South, Australian Greens
